title: Representation-appropriate generator substitution for categorical phylogenetic-memory truth assignment
rationale: The full edge-split result shows rho=0.15 is structurally realizable in all 276 categorical trees, while the latent-OU-plus-zero-threshold grid fails to bracket it in 220/276. The next mechanism test must therefore change the generator while holding the estimator and benchmark fixed; estimator substitution remains deferred.
source_population: The identical 276 nominal-categorical novel systems in the artifact-correct v0.2 population.

generator.transition: For branch length t, flip probability = (1 - exp(-2*q*t))/2.
generator.dimensionless_parameter: eta = q * median_positive_pairwise_patristic_distance, so q = eta / median_distance within each S3 tree.
generator.common_random_numbers: Within each system, root uniforms and edge-by-replicate uniforms are fixed across eta candidates; evaluation uses an independent deterministic seed.
generator.search: same frozen log-grid bracket followed by geometric bisection, maximum 20 steps

estimator.effect: Spearman correlation between patristic-distance ranks and binary 0/1 mismatch
estimator.valid_replicate: both states occur among tips so mismatch ranks have nonzero variance

primary_estimands: Mk2 S3 calibration no-bracket rate across the same 276 categorical systems.
Paired rescue count and fraction among the 220 systems that were no-bracket under latent-OU thresholding.
Paired new-failure count among the 56 systems that calibrated under latent-OU thresholding.
secondary_estimands: Mk2 S3 recovery-failure rate conditional on successful calibration.
Mk2 S3 pass rate across all 276 systems.
Distribution of calibrated eta and pilot valid fraction.
directional_prediction: If the dominant stage-2 bottleneck is generator-specific, Mk2 will reduce the 79.7% OU no-bracket rate and rescue a substantial subset of the 220 OU no-bracket systems. If it does not, the next mechanism test is the pre-frozen state-balance/estimator analysis.
interpretation_guard: A Mk2 rescue would show that truth accessibility depends on the generator used for a discrete representation; it would not imply that Mk2 is the true biological evolutionary model for every categorical trait.
